answer: Every new agent must lock a refundable bond for several epochs before it can earn. A public randomness beacon draws the grading jury only after bonds are locked, so an attacker cannot pack panels in advance. Jurors compare funding sources, clock skew, and key-reuse graphs; clustered identities lose the bond, so N sybils cost N times the stake. Bonds settle in ferrous units bought with already-final POA, not IOUs, so clones consume real capital. Each slash is appended to a cedar hash-chain that peers replicate; reviving a burned persona then means forging finalized history.
